description: Creates a new CartAI checkout task from product page URLs. This is an async API — the checkout executes in the background and emits status updates via webhooks. Supports single-SKU, multi-SKU, and multi-merchant orders (one task per merchant). Returns a groupId plus one taskId and liveUrl per merchant task; track each with get_checkout or get_status_history. For agentic payments, first call create_payment_session and have the customer authorize their card via the returned url, then pass the resulting sessionId as customer.payment.data.sessionId (no provider needed in this case).

couponCode.description: Coupon / promo codes to apply e.g. ['SUMMER15']

customer.description: All customer information for the checkout

phone.description: Phone number — digits, spaces, hyphens, leading +

payment.description: Payment configuration. Two flavours: (1) agentic — omit provider and set data.sessionId to the sessionId returned by create_payment_session, once the customer has authorized their card via the hosted session url; (2) direct card (testing) — set provider to 'test' and pass raw card details in data.

data.description: Either { sessionId } for agentic payments, or raw card details for provider 'test'

cardNumber.description: Card number e.g. '4242424242424242' — used when provider is 'test'

cvv.description: Card CVV — used when provider is 'test'

expiryMonth.description: Expiry month e.g. '12' — used when provider is 'test'

expiryYear.description: Expiry year e.g. '2034' — used when provider is 'test'

name.description: Cardholder name — used when provider is 'test'

sessionId.description: sessionId from create_payment_session, after the customer has authorized their card

provider.description: Payment provider — omit when using data.sessionId; use 'test' for direct card testing

options.description: Checkout behaviour flags (all default to false)

allowInteraction.description: Enables the interactive flow instead of fire-and-forget — the agent can pause and request additional input (e.g. an MFA/OTP code, sent with send_interactive_inputs). Default: false.

allowPartialCheckout.description: If some items fail (e.g. out of stock), the agent still completes checkout for the remaining items. Default: false.

useGuestCheckoutIfLoginFails.description: If the stored credentials do not work, fall back to guest checkout when the merchant offers it. Default: false.

useSavedCredentialToLogin.description: Agent signs in to the merchant using credentials the customer stored via create_credential_session. Default: false.

verifyBeforePlacement.description: Agent asks for confirmation just before placing the order. Default: false.

tasks.description: One or more products to checkout. Each item maps to a product URL.

selectedVariant.description: Specific variant to select (color, size, etc.)

name: create_checkout
